task: Write a Python function that extracts the AWS region from an S3 bucket URL. For example, 's3://my-bucket-us-east-1/path/to/file' should return 'us-east-1'.
Create a JSON object that represents an AWS IAM policy allowing read-only access to all objects in an S3 bucket named 'my-data-bucket'.
Write a regular expression that matches valid AWS EC2 instance IDs. Valid IDs start with 'i-' followed by exactly 17 hexadecimal characters (for example, 'i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8').
